# Akanta Global

> India-based bulk exporter of ball pens, jute bags, and custom branded stationery for global distributors, importers, and wholesale buyers.

Akanta Global manufactures and exports plastic ball pens, retractable click pens, metallic ball pens, custom logo pens, and eco-friendly jute bags from Nashik, Maharashtra. MOQ: 10,000 units for pens, 5,000 units for jute bags.

## Product Categories

- [Ball Pens](/products/ball-pens): Plastic ball pens for bulk orders.
- [Click / Retractable Pens](/products/click-retractable-pens): Push-button retractable pens.
- [Metallic Ball Pens](/products/metallic-ball-pens): Premium metal-finish pens for executive gifting.
- [Custom Logo Pens](/products/custom-logo-pens): Private-label pens with logo printing.
- [Jute Bags](/products/jute-bags): Eco-friendly jute bags for export.
- [Printed Jute Bags](/products/printed-jute-bags): Custom-printed promotional jute bags.
